name: What type of caulk is best for exterior applications on my home?

mainEntity.name: What type of caulk is best for exterior applications on my home?

acceptedAnswer.text: For exterior applications, durability, flexibility, and weather resistance are key. Polyurethane caulk is an excellent choice for its strong adhesion, flexibility, and resistance to harsh weather and UV rays, making it ideal for joints exposed to movement. Silicone caulk also offers superb flexibility and water resistance, but some types are not paintable. Acrylic latex caulk with silicone is suitable for less demanding exterior areas where painting is desired and some movement is expected. Choosing the right type depends on the specific surface and environmental conditions.
acceptedAnswer.description: Polyurethane caulk is often best for exterior due to durability and flexibility. Silicone is also good for water resistance. Acrylic latex with silicone suits paintable, less demanding areas.
